title: geranium neopumilum
intro: Geranium neopumilum, commonly known as Dwarf Rose, is a type of flowering plant species native to South Africa. It is known for its vibrant pink flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of Geranium neopumilum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
